ns2:section.sectionText: This course if available ONLY to students in the MHRIR online program. Those not accepted into the MHRIR online program will not be eligible to enroll. Synchronous Collaborative sessions: Thursdays, 6:00-8:00 pm central time on May 21, 28, June 4,11, 18 and 25. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperation Teachers waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC, and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.)
